intro: Epilepsy awareness means supporting the person, giving safe seizure first aid and recognising when a seizure has become an emergency.
points: Call 999 if a convulsive seizure lasts over 5 minutes, repeats without recovery, is a first seizure or causes injury.
Protect the person from injury, cushion their head, time the seizure and stay with them until they recover.
Never restrain the person or put anything in their mouth — you cannot swallow your tongue during a seizure.
Once jerking stops, roll the person into the recovery position and give nothing to eat or drink until fully alert.
This awareness course does not qualify you to give rescue medication like buccal midazolam; only trained, competent staff may.
Follow each person's care plan, record seizures accurately, and protect their dignity with warmth and privacy afterwards.
